description: Fail-closed verification: the model claims a finding at a proven line with a plausible-but-wrong snippet (it does not match the diff-proven line text) and confidence 0.99. The deterministic engine finds no evidence — a high-confidence claim never upgrades absence — so the finding is reported `unverified` and still shown with the badge. The run posts, because an all-unverified review is still a review.
